HECA.notes: No basic handling for 1–50 t in Cairo; every handler applies Hall 4 fee 900 USD per aircraft and Hall 4 150 USD per pax (arrival and departure separately, foreign pax). The panel prices every passenger as foreign. Egyptian passengers pay less for the Hall 4 terminal (ZAS 30, AVIARY 35 instead of 150); the adjustment row that carried this was removed on 20 Nov 2026 by user decision, so Egyptian passengers are not priced separately in the panel. Sources: Aero Services quote (CAI Airport Handling, GL6T 45.2 t), AN Aviation cost estimate (23 Aug 2026, by type), ZAS estimate (GLEX 44 t, 23 Aug 2026), AVIARY invoices INV 2026/4069 and 2026/4310. Group mapping: ALEX group GLEX price, ELL group GL6T price. Aero Services: basic handling 250 (all equipment except ACU/GPU/ASU and pushback), AJS supervision 25, follow-me 22 per use, departure tax 38 per pax, trash free, night landing 299 (ELL group); landing and housing in quote only for GL6T, other groups from earlier data. Parking 31.16 per hour, housing every started 24 h for stays over 5 h. AN Aviation: quote tech-stop/crew only; basic ramp equipment 450 (AFZ 526), supervision 200, landing permit free, VIP salon 2 h 300, terminal pax bus 100 per direction (in VIP bus row), slot 30 per direction. Night landing extra per night landing (CL60 20, E35L 20, GLF4 40, ALEX group 290 = GLEX price, ELL group 300 = GL6T price, AFZ 345) in Surcharge on night arrival (18:00–06:00, shared row). Parking 35 per hour, max daily fee per 24 h slot (user table). Departure pax tax not in quote. ZAS: ZAS services 200 (supervision), landing permit 25, security 25, follow-me and fire brigade 25 per trip, departure tax 35 per pax, Royal VIP lounge 2 h 900, crew lounge 400. Landing incl. 2 h parking; parking 32 per hour, housing every started 24 h for stays over 5 h (GLEX 246). Night landing 286 (GLEX). Quote only for GLEX; other groups from earlier data. AVIARY: supervision 125, disbursement 5% on all items excl. supervision; per departing pax 29 + 2 + 1, police screening 21, API 1.99; parking on invoices every started 24 h for stays over 5 h (E35L 174, ELL 253); hourly fee up to 5 h not seen on invoices, CAA tariff 32 assumed. Night landing difference not calculated in panel. Catering, visa, crew bus, loading etc. not in comparison; tick rows.
